Card Q&A.a: Yes. A 2-color card is treated as both colors, so you can activate both effects.
Card Q&A.q: If this card’s [On Play][When Digivolving] effect trashes a card that’s both purple and yellow, can I both delete 1 of my opponent’s level 3 Digimon and give 1 of my opponent’s Digimon -3000 DP for the turn?
When this card is in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with an effect that adds colors, such as “This Digimon is also treated as red,” does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card in your hand. If you trash a purple card, delete 1 of your opponent’s level 3 Digimon. If you trash a yellow card, 1 of your opponent’s Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] If this Digimon has 2 or more colors, gain 2 memory.
